data.gender_notes: Nazish is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of joy and happiness. Derived from the Urdu word 'nazana' which means 'to please'. The name Nazish carries the meaning “Delight, pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazish usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazish total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

In Islamic tradition, this name can be seen as a reminder to please Allah (SWT) above all else, and to strive to make Him happy by living a righteous and virtuous life. It is also a reminder to seek the pleasure of Allah in all of our actions and to seek His closeness and love. By living a life that is pleasing to Allah, the name "Nazish" can be a source of spiritual inspiration and motivation for the bearer, guiding them towards a more meaningful and productive existence.
